restrictions: Exact build only; any executable hash drift invalidates this manifest.
This manifest is not publisher or counsel approval.
No game-process instrumentation before the repository rights and runtime protection gates pass.
No captured content, account data, save data or device-unique identifiers may be committed.

size_on_disk_bytes tracks installed content, not build identity. Diagnose any mismatch against size_on_disk_breakdown.depots before revising it; executable.sha256 and source.build_id are the identity gates.
